Overlay: initialize the overlay with the calendars already selected for conflict checking and fetch their availability immediately after authentication. Use the requested date-range helpers and `lastVisibleDate` input to cover the displayed range. Pass an overlapping event's title through `useCheckOverlapWithOverlay` so the confirmation hover card (conflicting-slot hover card) can show it with the relevant time range. Continue modal: fetch the enabled social-login providers when the continue modal opens and offer the corresponding Google or Microsoft action.

Overlay week view shows the optional title from busy-time data. Split multi-day and all-day events into day-bounded display segments using `getEventSegmentForDay`, rendering each nonempty segment on its covered day. Keep end-boundary handling consistent so an event ending at midnight does not occupy the following day.

When the user picks the Google or Microsoft action from the overlay continue modal, connect that calendar during the existing sign-in flow and return to the booking page with overlay enabled, without broadening Google OAuth scopes.
